shared_elements: human figures shown in profile in low relief
figures walking/standing with one leg advanced
figures holding objects in outstretched hands
horizontal register borders framing a scene
procession-like alignment of figures facing one direction
decorative band of repeated motifs above the scene (rosettes / winged sun-disc arch)
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief human figures in strict profile, striding with one leg forward and holding objects before them, set within a framed register with a decorative band of repeated motifs running along the top. The biggest differences are that A is a continuous procession of several similarly dressed attendants leading a large naturalistic camel, while B is a compact confronted pair (an offerant facing a horned/disc-crowned deity) with columns of sign-like glyphs between them and no animal.
